Bihar Board Reopens 2027 Exam Form Submission Window

The Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has reopened the window for submitting application forms for the 2027 Class 10 and 12 examinations. Students can submit their forms until October 31, with a late fee applicable. The board had previously closed the initial application period.
